scene: Inside the bento rests three glowing rice-balls marked with transit routes.
picture: A flat side view of a bustling multi-transit concourse. Far left, a yellow retro streetcar waits with open doors. Left, the grandfather stands with his bicycle and plant crate, holding the open bento box. Centre, a wooden koi boat bobs in a canal dock. Far right, a leafy garden tram waits on raised rails.
shown: a yellow retro streetcar waiting at a platform gate on the far left
a carved wooden koi-shaped boat floating along a canal slipway at the centre
